statement: physics/curvature/curvature.ath: deficit angles in exact multiples of pi; a fan of d equilateral triangles is flat iff d = 6; on all 218 closed triangulated surfaces with <= 6 labelled vertices (1 + 10 + 195 spheres, 12 projective planes), the icosahedron and the 7-vertex torus, the deficits add to 2 pi chi.
